nalli:10068027932971.description: This handwoven silk saree with gold zari reimagines muthu kattam through a diamond brocade. A broad border with thazhampoo reku motifs blends into the body. nalli:10049569554731.description: Inspired by Indian lore, the killi motif symbolizes love and wisdom. Paired parrots shine in green meenakari. A bold emerald border with chakram frames the saree. nalli:10068560970027.description: This half-and-half saree blends tradition with modern elegance. Gold half-tissue pleats offer subtle shimmer, while black organza features spaced chintz florals. Delicate gold line art adds depth, enhancing the striking contrast of bright blooms against the dark fabric for a refined and balanced look.

nalli:10068552024363.description: This saree, crafted in pure silk organza, captures the essence of cherry blossoms (Sakura) with elegant blooms flowing across the fabric. Symbolising life's impermanence, renewal, and beauty, the delicate flowers evoke the fleeting nature of spring and timelessness.

nalli:10068547240235.description: Crafted in cotton tissue, this saree is inspired by the iris symbol of hope, wisdom, and nobility as seen in Japanese floral art. Decorative florals bloom along diagonal bels, intensifying near the pallu for a serene flow. A woven zari border with extra weft work adds elegance, while digitally printed hand illustrations and a tasselled pallu create a look of depth, harmony, and grace.

nalli:10068545765675.description: This saree is inspired by traditional Pichwai art, showcasing Kamadhenu, the divine cow, with her calf as symbols of prosperity, purity, and abundance. Crafted in pure silk organza, it merges Indian mythology with contemporary art.

nalli:10068541374763.description: Inspired by florals in Indian miniature paintings, this saree features delicate, hand-painted flower prints with vibrant colours and intricate details. Made in cotton tissue with pearl lace, the design highlights the beauty and harmony of spring.

nalli:10068538917163.description:
Showcasing intricate floral arrangements inspired by classic French fabric—Toile de Jouy, delicately detailed with shimmering gold embroidery, this design is framed by a broad gold band, enhancing its timeless elegance. Crafted in pure silk
organza with a digitally printed, hand illustrations. it features embroidery in the body for added richness.

nalli:10068533510443.description: Inspired by daffodils and pressed flowers, this saree captures nostalgic beauty with clean white lines tracing delicate floral curves. Golden zari accents enhance contrast, while bold blooms on the pallu add drama. Crafted in organza with digitally printed, hand illustrations. it features a gold beaded trim and zari embroidery in the pallu.

nalli:10068533084459.description:
Made from pure silk organza with a delicate pearl trim, this saree draws inspiration from Indian miniature paintings and French Toile de Jouy. Featuring hand-illustrated garden scenes with flowers and birds, it combines intricate artistry
and storytelling, offering a light, airy drape with timeless beauty and modern elegance.

nalli:10068381729067.description: Unveiling the "Dusky Diva" Bhagalpuri Plain Tussar Saree from Nalli's Yours Truly collection, celebrating minimalistic elegance for the modern season. Handwoven using traditional thigh-reeled yarn on a fly loom shuttle, it offers a silk-like texture and easy drape. The body has zari stripes, the border features temple motifs, and the pallu displays solid hues with zari accents.

nalli:10068381172011.description: Presenting the 'Metallic Magenta' Bhagalpuri Tussar Saree from the Yours Truly collection. A blend of tradition and minimalism, its metallic sheen adds modern elegance. Handwoven using thigh-reeled yarn on a fly shuttle loom, it features zari checks on the body, a plain border, and a pallu with intricate zari bands. Lightweight and breathable, perfect for stylish workwear.

nalli:10053220598059.description: The "Tropical Teal" Bhagalpuri Tussar Saree from Nalli’s Yours Truly Collection embodies tranquillity and renewal. Crafted using traditional thigh-reeled yarn on a fly shuttle loom, it features zari checks on the body, a plain border, and a lined pallu.
